text:
maria: FYI carrier flagged a customs hold on inbound EU trial racks (order RC-9812). estimated 72h delay, could impact the pilots tomorrow.

tariq: which racks? can we repurpose from us-west staging?

maria: 12 racks for two pilot sites. staging has 6 spares only.

olivia: asking partner if they can split shipment (6 now, rest later). awaiting reply.
jordan: if only 6 arrive, product says one pilot can run degraded; legal worried about SLA for the other.
tariq: options: 1) reassign EU pool to prioritize pilot A, 2) air-bridge remaining racks from us-west (fast, expensive), 3) delay pilot B with credits.
olivia: partner can expedite 4 racks through customs if we send amended commercial invoice.
supply-bot: [log] inventory_check --pool=staging-us-west --available=6
supply-bot: [log] inventory_check --pool=eu-warehouse --available=8
jordan: tally: 6 (staging) + 4 (partner expedite) = 10, still 2 short of 12.
maria: I can ask legal for a temporary carve to let pilot B run at reduced capacity; ops needs mitigation notes.
tariq: air-bridge cost ballpark?
olivia: carrier quoted $18k per rack expedited; 2 racks ~ $36k. finance sign-off required.
jordan: proposed plan: move 6 from staging -> EU, accept partner expedite for 4, run pilot B at 10/12 with credit, keep air-bridge as fallback.
maria: ok. Olivia update invoice and confirm partner expedite by EOD. Tariq schedule staging pickup. Jordan prepare customer comms and credit wording.
olivia: pinged partner @carrier-contact and cc'd customs-broker. they need invoice in 2h.
tariq: staging pickup booked 13:00 UTC. transit ~18h to consolidation hub then 12h last mile.
jordan: draft line: "Due to a customs hold, your pilot will start at reduced capacity. We will provide a credit for the impacted period. Full capacity expected by <date+5d>."
maria: timeline checklist: 1) partner confirm expedite (olivia) 2) invoice amendment submitted (olivia) 3) staging move scheduled (tariq) 4) customer comms ready (jordan) 5) finance fallback approval (maria). react with :thumbsup: when done.
supply-bot: [alert] hold_status_change order=RC-9812 status=HOLD ts=1768601405
maria: need go/no-go for air-bridge by 16:00 UTC. if partner can't do expedite, i'll escalate finance.
olivia: partner tentatively ok for 4, will confirm after invoice update.
maria: thanks team. I'll post final update in the partner channel when items green."
